dict.string: BetterShot records the shortcut keys you press during a recording, only when you turn on key capture, so the editor can show them on screen.
BetterShot shows your camera in a floating bubble when you turn on the face cam, so your face appears in the recording.
BetterShot records your microphone when you turn on the mic in the recording bar, so you can narrate what you capture.
BetterShot needs screen recording access to capture screenshots and record your screen.
BetterShot transcribes the audio in your recording so it can add captions, on your Mac where it can.
